finding: The frozen primary contrast is not estimable under the multinomial categorical-choice likelihood because each action×profile surface has an additive within-profile logit invariance.
invariance: For each profile p and surface s, adding the same constant to all four action logits leaves the categorical probabilities unchanged.
primary_contrast: Mean over 24 permutations × 4 profiles of FUTURE_REASSIGNED surface cell (permutation-aligned action, profile) minus STATIC_CONTROL identity surface cell (profile, profile).
estimability_test: The contrast has non-zero projection onto the likelihood null space; therefore its value changes under an observationally equivalent logit reparameterization.
interpretation_boundary: This is an algebraic/statistical design audit, not an empirical result.
No Monte Carlo power or type-I-error simulation is authorized by this finding.

No NEXT3 effect estimate, value/reward/performance signal, or empirical result is imported.
